summary.name: Sabaki
summary.one_liner: Sabaki is a free, open source, cross-platform Go (Baduk/Weiqi) board and SGF editor built on Electron web technology.
use_cases: analyze Go game variations with game tree
play Go against GNU Go or Pachi
edit and save SGF game files
summary.what_it_does: Sabaki is a Go board and SGF editor. It offers markup tools including an SGF 4-compliant line and arrow tool, and supports SGF game containers holding multiple games in one file. Reviews can be written in Markdown. It scores games by area or territory counting, with a score estimator and the ability to toggle life and death status of groups. A game tree lets users navigate variations and test-plays, and the page says it stays fast on huge trees. Users can play against GTP engines such as GNU Go and Pachi, or have two engines play each other, and a find mode locates a move on the board by clicking a spot.
notable: SGF 4-compliant line and arrow markup tools with multi-game SGF containers
Score estimator with life and death toggling
Fuzzy stone placement that simulates stones bumping on a real goban
Find move mode to jump to a move by clicking its board position
caveats: Platform-specific builds are not detailed on the page
